acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given the deployed media hub, When initiating playback, Then the audio must play without errors across desktop and mobile
Given the external links, When clicked, Then they must navigate correctly to the intended YouTube and Telegram destinations
notes: Automated Vitest component tests in podcast.test.ts verify audio playback state transitions (play/pause, audio ended event resetting state/time), seeking capabilities (timecodes, waveform, exported seekTo), and external YouTube/Telegram navigation links with correct target and rel attributes.
